rv.q: If you think that 'wiping away tears of laughter and sorrow' is one those activities that, like 'rolling in the aisles', only happens in reviews, you give should this show a visit.
It's flawed, for sure, but this joyous, cathartic musical looks set to see out many calendars.
By the end, their bravery and determination to 'Dare' can make even a sour and cynical critic's eye moisten.
